info.title: L2 Flow Execution Engine
info.description: L2 flow runtime organizer. It consumes L1.2 templates and manages flow instances.

now.description: Optional scheduler time; defaults to current UTC time.

flow.start.description: Create and run a flow instance.

flow.decide_human.description: Approve or reject a pending human task.

flow.dispatch_status.description: Receive subtask status from a delegated engine.

flow.scan_timeouts.description: Scan waiting human tasks and apply their preset timeout policy.

flow.design_from_text.description: Create a flow-design draft from a natural-language request for the shared design UI.

flow.design_list.description: List flow-design drafts by requester, status, or flow kind.

flow.design_update.description: Update a flow-design draft after the user or AI revises it.

flow.design_validate.description: Check whether a fixed or flexible flow design is reasonable before running or templating.

flow.design_convert_to_template.description: Convert a confirmed flexible/fixed design draft into an L1.2 fixed-template draft.

template.retrieve.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Read a published fixed process template for L2 runtime use.

template.create_draft.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Backward-compatible alias of template.register_draft.

template.update_draft.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Update an existing draft with externally confirmed template content.

template.publish.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Publish a draft as an immutable incrementing version after human confirmation.

template.disable.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Disable a template for new starts while keeping historical versions queryable.

template.list.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: List templates by structured filters.

template.audit.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Query module audit records.

template.export_catalog.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Export service registry, template summaries, and published definitions for L2 integration.

template.register_draft.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Register an externally prepared draft template. L1.2 validates and stores it, but does not design business content.

template.delete_unpublished.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Delete an unpublished draft-only template after human confirmation. Published templates are never physically deleted.

template.enable.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Re-enable a disabled template for new starts after human confirmation; no new version is created.

template.validate_definition.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Validate a template definition without persisting it.

template.export_template.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Export one template record and its selected published versions for maintenance handoff.

template.diff_draft.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Compare the current draft with the latest or specified published version.

template.impact_analysis.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Analyze draft changes against a published version and classify L2/runtime coordination impact.

template.governance_report.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Build a publish-readiness governance report for a template definition or stored template draft/version.

template.catalog_health.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Summarize template catalog health, governance warnings, category coverage, and service references.

template.import_bundle.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Import an exported template bundle as a validated draft. It does not start runtime instances.

template.clone_template.description: Forward L4 template-maintenance request to L1.2: Clone an existing draft or published version into a new validated draft template.

x-boundary: Consumes L1.2 templates and dispatches to L2 engine services. L2 owns flow design drafts and validation; L1.2 remains the system of record for confirmed fixed-template drafts and published versions.
